translations.web: According to their deeds, he will repay as appropriate, wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies; he will repay the islands their due.
translations.bsb: So He will repay according to their deeds: fury to His enemies, retribution to His foes, and recompense to the islands.
translations.kjv: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
